Illustrated by [[Ken Sugimori]][[a:File:BebeSearchMysteriousTreasures109.jpg|Bebe's Search (Mysterious Treasures 109)]]| gender=Female | hometown=[[Hearthome City]]| region=[[Sinnoh]]| game=yes | generation={{gen|IV}}, {{Gen|VIII}} | games={{game3|Diamond and Pearl|Diamond, Pearl|s}}, {{v2|Platinum}}, {{pkmn|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Brilliant Diamond, Shining Pearl}} | footnotes=}} '''Bebe''' (Japanese: '''ミズキ''' ''Mizuki'') is a computer technician who lives in [[Hearthome City]] in [[Sinnoh]]. An expert in computing, she created a [[Pokémon Storage System]], succeeding [[Lanette]]'s storage system. ==In the core series games== {{outdated|section|needs=more Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl info}} [[File:Bebes house.png|frame|Bebe's house in Hearthome City]] Bebe was introduced in [[Generation IV]] as an expert computer technician living in [[Hearthome City]] in the [[Sinnoh]] region. It was she who developed Sinnoh's [[Pokémon Storage System]] based on the previous designs of [[Bill]] and [[Lanette]]. Her house, which is next to the [[Pokémon Center]] in Hearthome, is not quite as cluttered as Lanette's. Bebe is good friends with [[Hayley]], who owns a [[My Pokémon Ranch|ranch in which Pokémon can be stored]], and they still keep in contact with each other. After the {{player}} obtains the [[National Pokédex]], she will give them a [[level]] 5 {{p|Eevee}} in {{2v2|Diamond|Pearl}}. This Eevee came from a [[Bill|good friend in Johto]] before being passed onto the player. In {{game|Platinum}}, the Eevee is at level 20, and available right away, without the need of the National Pokédex. In {{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}}, she is notably met earlier, in [[Jubilife City]]. After the player defeats the two {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s, she upgrades their Pokémon Storage System so it can be accessed anywhere, except in {{pkmn|Gym}}s and in the interior of the {{si|Pokémon League}}. She also gives the player [[Ball Capsule]]s. Like in the original games, she will give the player a level 5 Eevee once the player has obtained the National Pokédex. ===Pokémon=== ===={{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}}==== {{Pokémon |gen=4 |ndex=0133 |pokemon=Eevee |ability=Run Away |ability2=Adaptability |gender=both |type1=Normal |level=5 |move1=Tackle|move1type=Normal|move1cat=Physical |move2=Tail Whip|move2type=Normal|move2cat=Status |move3=Helping Hand|move3type=Normal|move3cat=Status}} ===={{game|Platinum}}==== {{Pokémon |gen=4 |ndex=0133 |pokemon=Eevee |ability=Run Away |ability2=Adaptability |gender=both |type1=Normal |level=20 |move1=Tackle|move1type=Normal|move1cat=Physical |move2=Helping Hand|move2type=Normal|move2cat=Status |move3=Sand-Attack|move3type=Ground|move3cat=Status |move4=Growl|move4type=Normal|move4cat=Status}} ===={{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}}==== {{Pokémon |gen=8 |ndex=0133 |pokemon=Eevee |ability=Run Away |ability2=Adaptability |gender=both |type1=Normal |level=5 |move1=Helping Hand|move1type=Normal|move1cat=Status |move2=Tackle|move2type=Normal|move2cat=Physical |move3=Growl|move3type=Normal|move3cat=Status |move4=Tail Whip|move4type=Normal|move4cat=Status}} ===Quotes=== {{incomplete|section|BDSP quotes}} ===={{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}}==== :''"Oh, you're a Trainer! {{color2|000|Generation IV}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Bebe Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Bebe in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===== In ''[[PS415|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia V]]'', Bebe appears alongside [[Hayley]] after Bebe's house was transported near Hayley's ranch. This was a result of {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga}} and {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia}} causing a distortion in the space-time continuum while fighting each other. ====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===== She then later introduces herself to {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} while helping [[Daisy Oak]] heal {{adv|Platinum}}'s Pokémon from the damage caused at the [[Spear Pillar]]. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Bebe |width=74 |pkmn=Glameow |type1=Normal |img=Bebe Glameow Adventures.png |epnum=PS415 |epname=Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia V |desc=Bebe's {{p|Glameow}} was only seen running with its Trainer when Bebe's house was transported near [[Hayley]]'s ranch.}} ==In the TCG== This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Bebe or her Pokémon in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{cardlist/header|Bebe|Supporter|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|Mysterious Treasures|Bebe's Search|109}}|type=Supporter|enset=Mysterious Treasures|enrarity=Uncommon|ennum=109/123|enset2=Secret Wonders|enrarity2=Uncommon|ennum2=119/132|enset3=Rising Rivals|enrarity3=Uncommon|ennum3=89/111|enset4=Miscellaneous Promotional cards|jpset=Secret of the Lakes|jprarity=Uncommon|jpset2=Unnumbered Promotional cards|jpset3=Bonds to the End of Time|jprarity3=Uncommon|jpnum3=081/090|jpset4=Advent of Arceus|jprarity4=Uncommon|jpnum4=089/090}} {{cardlist/footer|Supporter}} ==Trivia== * Bebe giving the main character an Eevee is a reference to Bill, as he gives the main character an Eevee in [[Generation II]] and {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}. * In {{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}} and {{game|Platinum}}, Bebe shares the same sprite with the {{tc|Battle Girl}} Trainer class. ** Her incarnation in the TCG and {{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}} is based on that of the Battle Girl, but with a different hairstyle, blue shorts, and no gloves. * In the Japanese version, Bebe speaks in Kansai dialect, much like [[Bill]].
